text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to ensure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work together smoothly. In test-driven development, programmers write tests before writing the actual code, which helps clarify what the code should do. This approach leads to better design and fewer bugs. Ultimately, a strong testing strategy builds confidence. Developers feel safe making changes because tests catch problems early, and teams can deliver more reliable software without constant fear of breaking something.
